thread:
maria: Heads-up — getting a bunch of 502s and elevated tail latency for hosted inference in ak2 since ~09:12 UTC. Multiple customer escalations. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.net/d/edge/ak2-latency (spike visible) :eyes:
kevin: seeing same. Gateway 502s + a surge in upstream timeouts. Sample gateway log: `upstream "model-backend" timed out (110: Connection timed out) while reading response header`
rahul: net metrics show packet retransmits and a brief spike in packet loss on ak2-egress veths starting 09:09–09:18 UTC. p99 rtt jumped ~120ms.
linda: any BGP flaps? which provider? @kevin can you paste the BGP summary from edge-router-01?
kevin: grabbing now — output cropped:
```
kevin: show ip bgp summary | include 64500
kevin: 64500     10.10.5.2     09:10:04  00:08  1   0    0    0  ESTABLISHED
kevin: 64500     10.10.5.3     09:10:05  00:07  1   0    0    1  IDLE (neighbor reset)
```
kevin: looks like provider ASN 64500 had a withdraw/reset around 09:10, then partial re-establish.
rahul: correlates with packet loss period. I pulled a short pcap from edge-router-01: lots of retransmits, some dup ACKs. command we ran:
```
rahul: sudo tcpdump -i eth0 host 203.0.113.22 and tcp port 443 -w /tmp/ak2-egress.pcap
```
maria: customer repro steps that support sent: `curl -v https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"model":"gpt-redwood-1","prompt":"hello"}'` -> 502 consistently during spike.
linda: quick mitigation: we can flip traffic to secondary transit (peer via eu-west2 interconnect) for affected routes + enable gateway fallback to model-variant-small to reduce backend pressure. Are we ok to run reroute?
kevin: I'm opening a temporary policy to prefer peer-2 for prefixes 198.51.100.0/24 -> stepping in. Applying now.
sre_bot: deploy:update-route-policy succeeded on edge-router-01 (run id: d8f3).
kevin: route policy pushed, BGP path now prefers peer-2; observing drop in packet retransmits already. p95 latency starting to decline.
support_tony: logged affected customers: 7 orgs reported errors, 3 high-severity. Created CS ticket CS-20314 and notified account owners.
maria: thanks — can you add the curl output and timestamps to the ticket? we need exact windows for billing/SLAs.
sre_bot: monitor:alert cleared for ak2-gateway-502-surge at 09:26 UTC (alert id: a-9012).
rahul: follow-up notes: provider X reported an upstream router experiencing microbursts (packet bursts) which caused TCP reordering and transient session resets. They applied corrective shaping at 09:20 UTC. We still prefer our reroute for additional stability.
linda: for short-term remediation I also increased gateway backend timeout from 30s to 45s for ak2 (will revert after) to reduce client-facing 502s while traffic stabilizes.
kevin: rolling bfd checks and route flaps look stable. Recording commands used for triage in the incident doc.
maria: good run — next: 1) postmortem + timeline, 2) confirm any billing credits with finance for impacted customers, 3) consider adding provider X to passive monitoring for per-prefix microbursts.
support_tony: noted. I'll coordinate credits and update customers in CS-20314.
kevin: actions captured: BGP reroute -> enabled, gateway timeout bumped, pcap archived (/var/tmp/ak2-egress.pcap), provider ticket opened (P-5879), customers notified.
linda: leaving a couple of commands here in case we need quick repro in future:
```
# quick repro curl (sanitized)
curl -v https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-redwood-1","prompt":"test"}'
```
maria: closing this slack thread — will attach incident link to PS postmortem doc. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
summary: 502/timeouts in ak2 caused by provider egress microbursts and BGP resets; rerouted traffic and bumped timeouts; CS tickets opened
